acquisition method: MS/MS was performed in the data-dependent mode at a resolution of 7.5 K
alkylation reagent: harvested in lysis buffer (250 mM HEPES, 1% Triton X-100, pH 7.0) containing freshly prepared 100 mM N-ethylmaleimide (NEM)
alkylation concentration: harvested in lysis buffer (250 mM HEPES, 1% Triton X-100, pH 7.0) containing freshly prepared 100 mM N-ethylmaleimide (NEM)
collision energy: using high-energy collision dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy setting of 45
enrichment method: loaded to Handee Mini-Spin columns containing 30 mg of preconditioned thiopropyl sepharose 6B resin
fragmentation method: using high-energy collision dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy setting of 45
instrument: Thermo Scientific LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer
MS analysis was performed on a Thermo Scientific LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer
ionization type: coupled with an electrospray ionization interface
labeling: followed by on-resin tryptic digestion and isobaric labeling with 6-plex tandem mass tags (TMT)
reduction reagent: The enriched peptides were dissolved in a final volume of 30 μL of water containing 20 mM DTT prior to LC–MS/MS analysis
reduction concentration: The enriched peptides were dissolved in a final volume of 30 μL of water containing 20 mM DTT prior to LC–MS/MS analysis
